mapper.sql: tenant_id = #{key.tenantId} AND environment_name = #{key.environment} AND cell_id = #{key.cell} AND namespace_name = #{key.namespace} AND campaign_id = #{key.campaignId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_runtime_bundle_head (tenant_id, environment_name, cell_id, namespace_name, campaign_id, last_sequence, updated_at) VALUES (#{key.tenantId}, #{key.environment}, #{key.cell}, #{key.namespace}, #{key.campaignId}, NULL, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE campaign_id = mk_runtime_bundle_head.campaign_id
mapper.select: SELECT last_sequence FROM mk_runtime_bundle_head WHERE FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_runtime_slot (tenant_id, environment_name, cell_id, runtime_name, namespace_name, desired_generation, activation_sequence, directive_signature, directive_json, updated_at, bundle_managed) VALUES (#{key.tenantId}, #{key.environment}, #{key.cell}, 'decision', #{key.namespace}, 0, 0, '', '', #{now}, TRUE) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bundle_managed = TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT activation_sequence FROM mk_runtime_bundle_directive WHERE AND directive_id = #{directiveId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_runtime_bundle_directive (tenant_id, environment_name, cell_id, namespace_name, campaign_id, activation_sequence, directive_id, directive_json, recorded_by, recorded_at) VALUES (#{key.tenantId}, #{key.environment}, #{key.cell}, #{key.namespace}, #{key.campaignId}, #{value.activationSequence}, #{value.directiveId}, #{value.directiveJson}, #{recordedBy}, #{value.recordedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_runtime_bundle_head SET last_sequence = #{sequence}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE AND last_sequence <=> #{expected,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: SELECT d.activation_sequence AS activationSequence, d.directive_id AS directiveId, d.directive_json AS directiveJson, d.recorded_at AS recordedAt FROM mk_runtime_bundle_head h JOIN mk_runtime_bundle_directive d ON d.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND d.environment_name = h.environment_name AND d.cell_id = h.cell_id AND d.namespace_name = h.namespace_name AND d.campaign_id = h.campaign_id AND d.activation_sequence = h.last_sequence WHERE h.tenant_id = #{key.tenantId} AND h.environment_name = #{key.environment} AND h.cell_id = #{key.cell} AND h.namespace_name = #{key.namespace} AND h.campaign_id = #{key.campaignId}
